review.why: Releases a new version of the resume app: version bump, changelog, pull request, tag and GitHub release.
review.summary: One pipeline: scope the release from the last tag, run translations first if needed, bump the root version, write the changelog entry in a fixed house style, run checks, open a pull request, tag the merged commit and create the release, then update a hosting package. It asks for an explicit yes before merging, tagging or publishing.
strengths: Shows exactly what will run and waits for a yes before publishing
The changelog entry and the release body are the same text
Table of common mistakes about versions and dates
cautions: Maintainer-only: needs the app's repository, runbooks and accounts
Tells the agent to leave any mention of AI out of titles, bodies and commits
Not relevant to resumes or job search
